text: Conn, Sensors. New thermal return, bearing two-eight-zero.
Conn, Fire control. Bearing only on Sierra Two. I need a leg to range her.
Conn, Engineering. Burn will run hot. Recommend a shorter one.
Conn, Thermal. Sink at eighty percent. Forced vent in twenty seconds.
Vampire, vampire. Bearing two-one-zero, impact in forty-five.
Captain, I can run the sensors for you. It would be faster. It would also be seen.
Skipper, breach in aft stores and a fire. Which first, the sink or the drive?
